name: nShift Delivery
author: nShift

sections.description:
nShift Delivery’s easy-to-use platform that saves you time. Grow internationally knowing you’re ready to send and give your customers the delivery experience they expect.
Sign up for our 14-day free trial now: https://www.nshiftdelivery.com/pricing

Explore nShift Delivery: https://www.nshiftdelivery.com/
Compatible Carriers: https://www.nshiftdelivery.com/carriers
Pricing: https://www.nshiftdelivery.com/pricing

Key Features

  • Create and print labels across multiple carriers from one shipping dashboard
  • Show your customers which carriers and services you offer, based on rules you set with our integrated delivery options in your checkout.
  • Simple returns – include a pre-printed return label or print-at-home
  • Branded tracking pages and shipping notifications
  • Parcel validation rules help you avoid errors, including customs documentation
  • Advanced tools for complex needs: bulk and batch printing, custom shipping automations (e.g. for Digital products which don’t need to be shipped) & advanced shipment status reports.
  • Ship with over 250+ carriers. PostNord, DB Schenker, DHL, DPD, Instabox, Bring, Posti, Budbee, Helthjem, Matkahuolto, CityMail, Royal Mail, GLS, FedEx, UPS, DSV and more.
sections.changelog:
• 1.0.5: DropPoints in checkout.
  • 1.0.1: High Performance Order Storage (HPOS) support.
  • 1.0.0: New plugin released.
